        # parse line

        if colon_index == -1:
            # violation: no colon
            valid = False
            error_line = line_num
            break
        prefix = line[:colon_index].strip()
        content = line[colon_index+1:].strip()
        type_lower = prefix.lower()
        if prefix not in ('Thought', 'Action', 'Action Input', 'Observation', 'Final'):
            valid = False
            error_line = line_num
            break
        # check state
        expected = None
        if state == 'start':
            if prefix != 'Thought':
                valid = False; error_line = line_num; break
        elif state == 'after_thought':
            if prefix not in ('Action', 'Action Input', 'Final'):
                valid = False; error_line = line_num; break
        elif state == 'after_action':
            if prefix not in ('Observation', 'Action Input'):
                valid = False; error_line = line_num; break
        elif state == 'after_action_input':
            if prefix != 'Observation':
                valid = False; error_line = line_num; break
        elif state == 'after_observation':
            if prefix != 'Thought':
                valid = False; error_line = line_num; break
        elif state == 'after_final':
            # no more lines allowed
            valid = False; error_line = line_num; break
        # if passed, add to trajectory and update state
        trajectory.append({"type": type_lower, "content": content})
        # update state based on prefix
        if prefix == 'Thought':
            state = 'after_thought'
        elif prefix == 'Action':
            state = 'after_action'
        elif prefix == 'Action Input':
            state = 'after_action_input'
        elif prefix == 'Observation':
            state = 'after_observation'
        elif prefix == 'Final':
            state = 'after_final'
    # after loop, if no violation yet

        # check end state

            # last line caused state to be not final; treat last line as violation
            valid = False
            error_line = len(lines)  # one-based index of last line
            # remove last entry from trajectory (since it's the violation)
            if trajectory:
                trajectory.pop()
        else:
            valid = True
            error_line = None
    return {"valid": valid, "error_line": error_line, "trajectory": trajectory}
